notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Give legal teams a relevant operating question.
intro: A proposed outbound workbench for PointOne, connecting firm-level research with timekeeping and prebill workflow discovery while preserving existing sales context.
queueIntro: Research fictional firms, offices and professional buying roles. No client matters, billing records, legal advice or claims of missed revenue are used.
workbenchIntro: Review a firm-level discovery brief before outreach. System compatibility and process needs must be confirmed during discovery, not inferred from a score.
firstBuild: A law-firm operating brief with an owned next step
firstBody: Connect firm identity, buying roles and a grounded timekeeping or prebill question to the current seller and sequence state.

fields.label: Firm, office and parent relationships checked
Legal operations or finance buyer role supported
Timekeeping or prebill workflow question grounded
Practice-management context marked known or unknown
Opportunity and reply state checked before sequencing

rules.title: Resolve the law-firm account
rules.next: Do not treat every office as a separate prospect or merge firms based on similar names.

rules.title: Find the operating decision owner
rules.next: Research the professional role responsible for timekeeping, billing operations or technology evaluation.

rules.title: Write a credible workflow question
rules.next: Use a sourced operational hypothesis. Do not claim the firm has lost billable time or billing errors without evidence.

rules.title: Separate system evidence from assumptions
rules.next: Capture the source for the current platform or keep it explicitly unknown for discovery.

rules.title: Keep the brief at firm level
rules.next: Use public business context, never client matters or privileged information, to personalize a conversation.

rules.title: Stop duplicate prospecting
rules.next: An active evaluation, booked meeting or reply needs the existing owner and a stopped outbound sequence.

ready.title: Ready for legal-operations discovery review
ready.next: The seller can review the account evidence and ask about the current workflow. No legal conclusions or billing-performance claims are implied.

experiments.name: Workflow-specific legal outreach
experiments.hypothesis: An operating question is more relevant than generic AI language.
experiments.treatment: Sourced timekeeping or prebill discovery question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Lifecycle-aware outbound
experiments.hypothesis: Synchronizing replies and opportunities reduces conflicting contact.
experiments.treatment: Shared account key and stop-state review
experiments.guardrail: Messages after a reply or active evaluation
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the legal buying workflow
roadmap.body: Learn which firm roles own timekeeping, billing and technology decisions. Define supported research fields.
roadmap.measure: Correct firm relationships and buyer-role coverage

roadmap.title: Build a narrow outbound engine
roadmap.body: Pilot source-backed briefs, enrichment exceptions and lifecycle-aware handoffs with the sales team.

roadmap.title: Measure through held discovery
roadmap.body: Test segments and messages with consistent account cohorts. Document system maintenance and rep corrections.

metricsTitle: Count qualified firm conversations, not message volume.
metricsIntro: Synthetic matched cohorts show different outbound approaches over the same observation window.
metricsNotes: These small invented cohorts do not establish causality or PointOne performance.
Exclude active evaluations before randomizing new-account outreach.
Keep scheduled meetings, held meetings, qualified opportunities and closed revenue separate.
aiApplication: At PointOne, I would coordinate public firm research around timekeeping and prebill questions, preserve existing seller and sequence state, and use an accountable review loop to improve relevance. Confidential legal matters would stay outside prospect research.
